# libmicrohttpd 1.0.1

Unmodified source archive: https://ftp.gnu.org/gnu/libmicrohttpd/libmicrohttpd-1.0.1.tar.gz

SHA256: `a89e09fc9b4de34dde19f4fcb4faaa1ce10299b9908db1132bbfa1de47882b94`

The archive contains its original LGPL-2.1-or-later/eCos license notices and
complete library source. Built locally as a static library with TLS, tools and
examples disabled, following the websrv 0.34 build guidance to use `-O1`.
Build output stays in the selected build directory, not the SDK installation.
